scope: CPU common-C-task chr7 selection evaluation and, only after both C contexts PASS and C checkpoint/ensemble/adequacy freeze, dedicated chr7 negative-only calibration. No model execution, test, external, or candidate access.

prediction_interface.numerical_storage: round-tripping decimal probabilities; orientation scores are original actual-network outputs represented in float64
prediction_interface.evaluation: convert probability strings only for exact selected chr7-role IDs, independently recompute symmetric per-seed mean and equal-three-seed float64 mean; stored q/ensemble values, if supplied, must match exactly

prerequisites: Hash-bound frozen specification, construction evidence, all18 selected checkpoints, checkpoint freeze, and real-network invariance evidence PASS covering every seed/configuration/model and ensemble. No synthetic invariance substitution.

metric_conventions.AP: Stepwise average precision, not trapezoidal PR-AUC; sort descending scores with stable mergesort, aggregate exact probability ties, sum precision times recall increments.
metric_conventions.AUROC: Tie-aware probability of positive exceeding negative, plus half weight for exact score ties; weighted pair count equals sklearn roc_auc_score.
metric_conventions.BrierSkill: 1-Brier/[prevalence*(1-prevalence)], with each bootstrap replicate's own weighted prevalence.
metric_conventions.AP_gain: AP minus each replicate's own weighted prevalence, before computing percentile bounds.
metric_conventions.undefined: One-class bootstrap draws invalid with no imputation; one-class descriptive strata have empty undefined metric fields. All scores must be finite in[0,1].
metric_conventions.seed_SD: sample standard deviation ddof=1 on the three seed AP point estimates, fixed seed order
metric_conventions.reliability: ten fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; empty bins retained; no fitted recalibration

bootstrap_conventions.represented_component_order: sorted lexical component_id via numpy.unique; fixed within each context
bootstrap_conventions.rng: fresh numpy.random.default_rng(314159) for each model context; no cross-context pairing claim
bootstrap_conventions.draw: numpy Generator.integers(0,n_components,size=n_components); bincount multiplicities; row weight equals multiplicity of that row's global component
bootstrap_conventions.paired: identical component draws/rowweights across A/B/C within a context
bootstrap_conventions.retention: only strict lower95 bounds for C absolute adequacy; A/B ordering and90% bounds never used for retention
bootstrap_conventions.generalization: conditional internal genomic-component uncertainty, not independent-donor or population uncertainty

stratification_conventions.cutpoint_source: all retained V2-C TRAIN positives in corresponding model context only
stratification_conventions.quintiles: numpy.quantile([.2,.4,.6,.8],method=linear); numpy.searchsorted(cutpoints,value,side=right)+1; repeated boundaries may produce empty bins
stratification_conventions.interpretation: all stratified metrics descriptive; explicitly flag n<100 cells; never derive cutpoints from chr7 or chr8-9

calibration_conventions.release_freeze_required: Allsix C checkpoints, fixed ensemble and symmetric implementation, passed adequacy decision hashed before calibration.
calibration_conventions.inputs: Dedicated common chr7 calibration panel metadata may contain positives for transparent counts, but only negative IDs have prediction strings converted or used.
calibration_conventions.ties: Boundary ties all excluded. Threshold may exceed1; no clipping or splitting ties.
calibration_conventions.serialization: float.hex and format(.17g), both exact float64 round-trip verified
calibration_conventions.claim_limit: observed calibration-row FPR only; no population or variant FPR guarantee; no allele-delta threshold

predictions.path: same frozen prediction file as evaluation

gate_preparation_helper.source_binding_chain: Initial independent integrity report/checks anchor original1.1freeze and checksumledger; original ledger binds unchanged readiness/specification/construction sources; executed training gate binds prepared input manifest and actual inference scripts; all18checkpointfreeze binds selected/completed/history/contract records; actual-network audit binds those checkpoints, input/cache manifests, predict_chr7.py and phase_two_contract.py, and all prediction/independent-RC files. All24unique audit units, counts and numerical tolerance results must PASS. Prediction scores are opaque-hashed, not evaluated by the helper.
gate_preparation_helper.calibration_source_binding: Reverify complete original evaluation source chain and unchanged evaluator implementation, all evaluation artifact hashes, BOTH C decision statuses, every exact adequacy-table condition including numeric strict-null boundaries, and underlying2000valid bootstrap audit. Freeze allsix exact Ccheckpoint hashes and both inference implementation files before deriving negative-only calibration inputs.
gate_preparation_helper.execution: Helper only derives append-only hash-bound provenance gates; no model, evaluation, calibration, test or external execution. Neither calibration file is created if C fails/inconclusive.

overwrite_policy: Refuse any nonempty output directory. Scientific redesign/retraining after outcomes requires separately authorized new version. Infrastructure exceptions are not permission to alter predictions or prespecified rules.
